name: Brasofensine
summary: Brasofensine (NS-2214, BMS-204756) is a phenyltropane dopamine reuptake inhibitor that had been under development by Bristol-Myers Squibb and defunct company NeuroSearch for the treatment of Parkinson's and Alzheimer's diseases.

pharmacology.text: Brasofensine (NS-2214, BMS-204756) is a phenyltropane dopamine reuptake inhibitor that had been under development by Bristol-Myers Squibb and defunct company NeuroSearch for the treatment of Parkinson's and Alzheimer's diseases.

summaryZh: 布索芬新是一種含氮有機氯化合物，化學式C16H20Cl2N2O，可作為多巴胺再攝取抑制劑，由百時美施貴寶和已解散的NeuroSearch公司作為帕金森氏病和阿爾茨海默病藥物研發。
summaryZhHans: 布索芬新是一种含氮有机氯化合物，化学式C16H20Cl2N2O，可作为多巴胺再摄取抑制剂，由百时美施贵宝和已解散的NeuroSearch公司作为帕金森氏病和阿尔茨海默病药物研发。

sideEffects.en: Its development did not continue, so its effects in people are not well documented. Dopamine reuptake inhibitors can cause nausea, sleeplessness, a fast heartbeat and, in Parkinson's disease, involuntary movements.
sideEffects.zh: 它的開發並未繼續，因此對人體的作用紀錄不多。多巴胺回收抑制劑可能造成噁心、失眠、心跳加快，在帕金森氏症患者身上還可能引起不自主動作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的开发并未继续，因此对人体的作用纪录不多。多巴胺回收抑制剂可能造成恶心、失眠、心跳加快，在帕金森氏症患者身上还可能引起不自主动作。

fact.en: It is a phenyltropane, built on the same ring skeleton as cocaine, but it was developed as a Parkinson's treatment on the idea that blocking dopamine reuptake would make the brain's remaining dopamine go further.
fact.zh: 布索芬新屬於苯基托烷類，骨架與古柯鹼相同，但它被開發為帕金森氏症的治療藥物，構想是阻斷多巴胺回收能讓腦中殘餘的多巴胺發揮更大作用。
fact.zhHans: 布索芬新属于苯基托烷类，骨架与古柯碱相同，但它被开发为帕金森氏症的治疗药物，构想是阻断多巴胺回收能让脑中残余的多巴胺发挥更大作用。
